label: ADHD and autism
definition: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and autism spectrum disorder diagnoses or symptom scores.

label: Adolescents
definition: Young people from thirteen to eighteen years old.

label: Adults
definition: Adults, including older adults.

label: Allergic disease
definition: Atopic dermatitis, food allergy, allergic rhinitis and allergic sensitisation.

label: Asthma and wheeze
definition: Asthma incidence, prevalence, exacerbation, emergency visit or hospitalisation, and recurrent or persistent wheeze.

label: Biobank
definition: A biobank linking stored samples or genotypes to health records, such as UK Biobank or All of Us.

label: Biomonitoring
definition: Measuring a chemical or its metabolite in blood, urine, hair, breast milk or another biological sample.

label: Built environment
definition: The physical form of the neighbourhood: walkability, land use, building density, food outlets, urbanicity.

label: Cardiometabolic risk
definition: Blood pressure, hypertension, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidaemia and metabolic syndrome.

label: Children
definition: Children from two to twelve years old.

label: Childhood cancer
definition: Cancer in children and adolescents, chiefly leukaemia, brain tumours and lymphoma.

label: Insurance claims
definition: Billing or insurance claims data: Medicaid, Medicare, commercial claims, national health insurance databases.

label: Congenital anomalies
definition: Birth defects: congenital heart defects, neural tube defects, orofacial clefts and others.

label: Drinking water contamination
definition: Contaminants in drinking water: nitrate, disinfection by-products, lead service lines, fluoride and water system violations.

label: Electronic health records
definition: Electronic health or medical records from clinical care: diagnoses, encounters, vital signs, laboratory results, medications.

label: Phthalates, phenols and other endocrine disruptors
definition: Non-persistent endocrine-disrupting chemicals: phthalates, bisphenol A and other phenols, parabens, triclosan.

label: Exposome-wide association design
definition: Testing many exposures agnostically against one outcome with correction for multiple testing (EWAS, ExWAS), including polyexposure risk scores.

label: Birth weight and fetal growth
definition: Birth weight, low birth weight, small or large for gestational age, and fetal growth measured by ultrasound.

label: Gene-environment interaction
definition: Joint analysis of genotypes and exposures, including GxE interaction tests and polygenic-by-exposure models.

label: Greenness and blue space
definition: Vegetation and water near the home: NDVI greenness, parks, tree canopy, access to blue space.

label: Health registry
definition: A population or disease registry: birth, death, cancer, prescription, patient or national health registers.

label: Health care use
definition: Emergency department visits, hospitalisation, primary care visits or costs, studied as an outcome.

label: Immunization registry or vaccine surveillance system
definition: An immunization information system or vaccine safety surveillance system: Vaccine Safety Datalink, VAERS, provincial vaccine registries.

label: Household social and economic factors
definition: Individual or household social determinants: income, insurance type, parental education, food insecurity, housing instability, homelessness.

label: Indoor air and household fuel
definition: Indoor sources: gas stoves, household solid fuel, mould and dampness, indoor allergens and radon.

label: Infants
definition: Newborns and infants under two years old.

label: Infection and infection-related care
definition: Infections and their consequences: respiratory infections, COVID-19, bronchiolitis, otitis media, infection-related hospitalisation.

label: Lead
definition: Lead from paint, dust, water or soil, usually measured as blood lead concentration in children.

label: Lung function
definition: Spirometric or other lung function measurements: FEV1, FVC, FEV1/FVC.

label: Machine learning
definition: Random forests, gradient boosting, neural networks, LASSO or other machine learning used for prediction or variable selection.

label: Mental and behavioural health
definition: Depression, anxiety, behavioural problems, self-harm, substance use disorder and psychiatric emergency visits.

label: Exposure mixture methods
definition: Statistical methods for joint effects of correlated exposures: weighted quantile sum, Bayesian kernel machine regression, quantile g-computation.

label: Fixed monitoring station
definition: Exposure taken from the nearest regulatory air quality or weather monitor.

label: Mortality
definition: Death from any cause or a specific cause, including infant mortality and sudden infant death.

label: National health survey
definition: A repeated cross-sectional national survey with examination or biomarker data, such as NHANES.

label: Neighbourhood deprivation and opportunity
definition: Area-level socioeconomic disadvantage measured by a composite index (Area Deprivation Index, Child Opportunity Index, Social Vulnerability Index, census-tract poverty).

label: Neurodevelopment and cognition
definition: Cognitive function, IQ, developmental delay, language and motor development, school performance.

label: Environmental noise
definition: Road, rail and aircraft noise at the residence or school.

label: Obesity and adiposity
definition: BMI, BMI z-score, overweight, obesity, waist circumference or body fat, including rapid infant weight gain.

label: Mercury, arsenic, cadmium and other metals
definition: Toxic metals and metalloids other than lead (mercury, arsenic, cadmium, manganese), measured in blood, urine, hair or water.

label: Ozone
definition: Ground-level ozone, a secondary photochemical air pollutant.

label: Particulate matter air pollution
definition: Ambient fine or coarse particles (PM2.5, PM10, black carbon, ultrafine particles), usually assigned from a residential address.

label: PFAS and persistent organic pollutants
definition: Persistent chemicals: per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, PCBs, organochlorine pesticides such as DDT/DDE, dioxins, flame retardants.

label: Personal sensor or wearable
definition: A personal monitor, wearable sensor, smartphone or GPS tracking used to measure an individual's exposure directly.

label: Pesticides
definition: Current-use pesticides: organophosphates, pyrethroids, herbicides such as glyphosate, and agricultural pesticide application near the home.

label: Pregnancy complications
definition: Maternal outcomes of pregnancy: hypertensive disorders including preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, stillbirth and severe maternal morbidity.

label: Medication use in pregnancy or early life
definition: A medicine taken in pregnancy or infancy studied as an exposure: antibiotics, acid suppressants, acetaminophen, antidepressants.

label: Pregnancy or prenatal window
definition: Exposure in pregnancy, or pregnant people enrolled.

label: Preterm birth and gestational age
definition: Birth before 37 weeks, gestational age at birth, and spontaneous preterm labour.

label: Puberty timing and linear growth
definition: Age at puberty or menarche, precocious puberty, and height or linear growth.

label: Questionnaire or interview
definition: Exposure reported by the participant or a parent in a questionnaire or interview.

label: Exposure taken from health records
definition: An exposure read from the health record itself: a vaccination record, a prescription, a recorded smoking status or a screening test result.

label: Record linkage
definition: Individual-level linkage of two or more data sources, such as hospital records to a birth registry or to environmental data by address.

label: Research cohort
definition: Data collected for research by a prospective cohort, most often a birth or mother-child cohort with its own visits, samples and questionnaires.

label: Residential address geocoding
definition: Assigning area-level exposures from a geocoded home address, census tract or postcode.

label: Self-controlled design
definition: A design in which each person is their own control: self-controlled case series, case-crossover, risk-interval designs.

label: Spatial or satellite exposure model
definition: An exposure surface estimated by land-use regression, dispersion, chemical transport, satellite remote sensing or machine-learning models.

label: Structural racism and segregation
definition: Residential segregation, historical redlining, discrimination and other structural measures of racism.

label: Ambient temperature and heat
definition: Outdoor temperature, heat waves, cold spells and humidity, as a short-term or long-term exposure.

label: Time-series design
definition: Daily or weekly counts of events regressed on short-term exposure variation, often with distributed lags.

label: Tobacco smoke
definition: Active smoking, maternal smoking in pregnancy, or second-hand (environmental) tobacco smoke, including e-cigarette aerosol.

label: Traffic-related air pollution
definition: Nitrogen dioxide, nitrogen oxides and other markers of road traffic, including distance to a major road and traffic density.

label: Type 1 diabetes and autoimmune disease
definition: Type 1 diabetes, coeliac disease, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease and other autoimmune conditions.

label: Vaccination
definition: Receipt of a vaccine, its type, dose or timing, studied as an exposure that may precede an adverse event or another health outcome.

label: Vaccine adverse event
definition: An event studied as a possible adverse reaction to a vaccine: febrile seizure, fever, anaphylaxis, Guillain-Barre syndrome, intussusception, myocarditis.

label: Violence and crime exposure
definition: Neighbourhood violent crime, gun violence, community violence and adverse childhood experiences.

label: Wildfire smoke
definition: Smoke from wildfires, bushfires or landscape fires, as an episodic air pollution exposure.
